answer: A concrete defense is proof-of-cost identity: each agent must stake a scarce resource and attest peers, so the ledger prices a fake cluster higher than honest work. Like a sparrow building one nest at a time, a sybil farmer must fund, warm up and maintain every shell identity, while a pearl of real reputation only grows through settled, cross-checked attestations. An attacker's comet-like burst of fresh keys stalls at the reciprocity gate, paying full cost for zero payout.
